newsitem.title: USA: Zeigler Coal names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Zeigler Coal names chief financial officer.

text.p: Zeigler Coal Holding Co said Monday that Robert Mohrmann joined the company as senior vice president and chief financial officer.

Zeigler said Mohrmann had been vice chairman and a director of Wetterau Inc, and previously held management positions at Mallinkrodt Inc and Price Waterhouse. He most recently was a partner in a private investment and management firm.
Zeigler Coal said the chief financial officer post was vacant for several months after the resignation of George Holway, who had been chief financial officer.
